title: Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 2: Field Equations and Observable Mapping (µ, Σ, S8)
description: Derives the field equations of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) from an entropy-gradient principle, defines the entropy field S(a) and its coupling to the effective gravity parameters µ(k, z) and Σ(k, z), and maps these to observables fσ8, S8, and a regime response surface. The paper presents sealed blind predictions and reports consistency checks against DES Y6, KiDS-1000, DESI DR2, and BOSS DR12, while documenting an erratum that corrects the growth-ODE friction term without affecting reported numerical results.

entropy_coupling_mu.description: Derived coupling of the entropy field S(a) to the effective gravitational strength; β ≈ 0.16 from SPARC calibration, not treated as a free parameter.

sigmoid_gate_mu.description: Phenomenological sigmoid gate for the growth-era suppression (µ < 1), with amplitude B > 0, transition epoch a_t, and sharpness n.

gaussian_mu.description: Gaussian epoch-parameterization of µ(a) used in MCMC sampling.

efc_kernel_mu_kz.description: Scale-dependent EFC kernel combining the spatially averaged entropy field and the Fourier-space entropy-to-density ratio; recovers GR when S̄ → 0 and s̃ → 0.

field_equation_entropy_gradient.description: Schematic metric-level field equation expressing gravitational response as a functional of the entropy gradient and local energy-flow density; reduces to Einstein’s equations when ∇S → 0.

growth_ode.description: Corrected linear growth-rate equation for f(a) = d ln D / d ln a with µ(a) entering as an effective gravitational coupling; reduces to ΛCDM when µ = 1. Erratum v2 clarifies the friction term.

background_gate_alpha_L2.description: Proposed background-level L2 gate (deprecated by data); current EFC phenomenology operates in the perturbation sector only.

regime_transition_theta.description: Smooth regime-transition function used in the (now inactive) background gate.

f_sigma8_mapping.description: Observable mapping from µ(a) to the redshift-space growth observable via the linear growth factor D(z).

key_results.main_finding: EFC provides a concrete entropy-field coupling to effective gravity (µ, Σ), a validated mapping to fσ8 and S8, and sealed blind predictions consistent with DES Y6, KiDS-1000, DESI DR2, and BOSS DR12; an erratum corrects the growth-ODE friction term without altering reported inferences.
parameters_tested: µ(a) sigmoid gate parameters (B, a_t, n)

sealed_predictions.statement: A sealed blind prediction for fσ8 at z = 0.7 (generated 2026-02-18 via NUTS) with growth suppressed relative to ΛCDM due to µ(a) < 1 in the L2 regime.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Independent RSD measurements at z ≈ 0.7 from DESI DR2/DR3 or equivalent, compared to the time-stamped sealed value.

sealed_predictions.statement: µ(a) remains consistent with unity at early times (S → 0; z ≳ 2) and transitions to µ(a) < 1 at late times following a sigmoid gate.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint constraints on µ(z) from high-z CMB/Lyα and low-z RSD+lensing that either require µ ≠ 1 at z ≳ 2 or prefer µ ≥ 1 at 0.2 < z < 1 at > 3σ.

kill_criteria: KC1: If combined RSD+lensing analyses constrain µ(a) = 1.00 ± 0.01 with no late-time suppression (µ < 1) across 0.2 < z < 1 at > 3σ, the EFC growth-era coupling (Eq. 2) is falsified.
KC2: If the sealed blind prediction for fσ8(z = 0.7) lies > 3σ away from updated RSD measurements (e.g., DESI DR2/DR3), the observable mapping from µ(a) to fσ8 (Eq. 9) fails.

KC3: Detection of non-vanishing EFC-like modifications at high redshift (z ≳ 2), i.e., µ(z) − 1 ≠ 0 at > 3σ, contradicting the S → 0 recovery limit and falsifies the entropy-gradient principle in its presented form.

KC4: Robust constraints showing no allowed scale dependence in the growth/lensing sector (|\tilde s/\tilde \delta| → 0) over the k-range where EFC predicts a non-zero kernel term (Eq. 4), at > 3σ, would rule out the scale-dependent kernel.

KC5: A cross-consistent set of Solar System, lensing, BAO, and growth measurements requiring µ ≥ 1 (enhanced growth) at late times at > 3σ would contradict the EFC-predicted weakened growth (µ < 1) regime.

related_packages.role: Validation and cross-check pipeline for growth-rate predictions cited in the paper
